items.headline: Council scheduled interviews for Environmental Planning Commission applicants
items.summary: The City Council's October 20 study session, set for 6:30 p.m., was listed as interviews of applicants for the Environmental Planning Commission. That commission advises on land-use and environmental matters.

items.headline: Cupertino council agenda: how to lease city-owned property on Stevens Creek
items.summary: The October 20 City Council agenda listed a proposed approach for leasing the City-owned commercial property at 22100 Stevens Creek Boulevard.

items.headline: Station Area Task Force agenda: draft Specific Plan and Benton-Brokaw crossing study
items.summary: The October 15 Station Area Task Force agenda listed a review of the complete draft Santa Clara Station Area Specific Plan. It also listed a public hearing on the Benton-Brokaw Multimodal Crossing Feasibility Study.

items.headline: AT&T seeks to add antennas to utility poles near Guinda and Homer
items.summary: The October 15 Architectural Review Board agenda listed a hearing on AT&T's request to add antennas, radio units and seven-foot fiberglass pole extensions to two city-owned wood utility poles. The poles are in the public right-of-way near 670 Guinda Street and 754 Homer Avenue. The project is listed as exempt from CEQA as an existing-facilities project.

items.headline: Council agenda: El Niño readiness, Anderson Dam, Pure Water updates
items.summary: The October 13 City Council agenda listed a joint update on El Niño preparedness for the 2026-2027 rainy season. It also listed updates on the Anderson Dam seismic retrofit and Coyote Creek flood protection projects, and on the Pure Water Silicon Valley potable reuse project.

items.headline: Council agenda lists release of documents on Cubberley purchase offer
items.summary: The October 13 City Council agenda included an item on the potential release of documents related to an offer to purchase the Cubberley Community Center property. The agenda gave no further detail on the offer or who made it.

items.headline: Peery Park plan amendment would add offices, R&D space, homes, and move water tower
items.summary: The Planning Commission's October 12 special study session agenda listed a proposed Peery Park Specific Plan amendment to increase office and R&D square footage and residential units, and to allow relocating the Libby Water Tower. The meeting also served as a scoping session for public comments on the Notice of Preparation for a Supplemental EIR to the 2016 Peery Park plan EIR.

items.headline: Mountain View council scheduled City Attorney candidate interviews
items.summary: The City Council's October 10 closed-session agenda, set for 8:00 a.m., listed a public employee appointment for the position of City Attorney, described as candidate interviews. The listing shows the city was recruiting for its top legal officer.
